scope.purpose: Operationalize ISO 19650-2:2018 5.3.5 by establishing a traceable proposed delivery-team mobilization plan for initiation and implementation during mobilization under 5.5.
scope.boundary: This workflow plans mobilization. It does not claim that planned activities have already been executed or verified, and it does not assign the prospective lead appointed party function from a TIVERIT job title.

iso_alignment.rule: Each applicable mobilization activity shall identify its proposed approach, timescale and responsible project actor/function. Missing project evidence remains unresolved.

status_semantics.planned: A supported mobilization approach, timescale and responsibility have been established.
status_semantics.unresolved: One or more required planning dimensions or authority mappings are not supported.
status_semantics.not_applicable: The activity is not applicable and the governing rationale is recorded.

process.rule: Map the prospective lead appointed party function through appointment/BEP/RACI or equivalent project evidence. Do not infer it from a TIVERIT role or platform permission.
Evaluate all eleven 5.3.5 activity groups for applicability; do not silently omit an activity.
For every applicable activity capture the proposed approach, timescale and responsible project actor/function.

Reference relevant 5.3.2 technology/production proposals, 5.3.3 task-team assessments, 5.3.4 delivery-team summary, CDE requirements and project information-management arrangements where they support the mobilization plan.
Assemble the planned activities without representing planning evidence as proof that mobilization has already occurred.
Preserve the plan as an input to mobilization under ISO 19650-2:2018 5.5; execution evidence is governed separately from this pre-appointment plan.

conformance_rules.rule: All eleven 5.3.5 activity groups shall be evaluated as applicable, not applicable with rationale, or unresolved.
Each applicable activity shall identify approach, timescale and responsibility.
A proposed mobilization plan shall not be represented as evidence that mobilization activities have been completed or successfully tested.
Project CDE planning and delivery-team distributed CDE planning shall remain distinct where a distributed CDE is applicable, including connectivity between them.
Education and training shall remain distinguishable as knowledge and skills interventions rather than being collapsed into an unsupported generic competency statement.
Recruitment for capacity and support for parties joining during the appointment shall be addressed separately where applicable.
The actor establishing the plan shall be mapped to the prospective lead appointed party function through project evidence.

provenance.migration_note: ISO-IMP-003 5.3.5 pass. Converts the mobilization-plan requirement into eleven traceable planning activity groups while separating pre-appointment planning from later mobilization execution.
